author: Reggie32
quote:
I was so pumped for this game. But on this showing the GTA franchise is dead.

PROS
- The graphics, and scenery are exceptional.

CONS.
- this game just isnt fun.
- long boring missions of girlfriend and household chores.
- lack of chaos and freedom.
- 'protected groups' that cannot be harmed.
- MMC cannot get with other women but does sleep with his male friend.
- basically a boring relationship simulator.
- feminist slop.
- previous edgy and funny content that mocked everyone has disappeared. I didnt laugh or raise a smile once.

I wanted this to be great. But GTA has abandoned its core audience. I wont come back to this franchise again.
